nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build producing a minimal nginx-based production image for the frontend application. The builder stage compiles the React/Vite application, and the runtime stage serves static assets with a custom nginx configuration running as non-root.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-stage build separates the Node.js build environment from the lightweight nginx runtime. Non-root nginx configuration enhances container security. Static assets are served from /usr/share/nginx/html with custom nginx.conf.
